summary.en: Workplace chat and meetings app widely used in China. Linaro's catalog lists it as running under emulation.
summary.zh-TW: 中國廣泛使用的職場通訊與會議軟體。Linaro 目錄列為透過模擬執行。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Vendor page could not be read from this environment; the result rests on the Linaro catalog alone.
caveats.zh-TW: 此環境無法讀取原廠頁面，結果僅依據 Linaro 目錄。
